question: Pandit Ram Dayal Sharma was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for Nautangi, Swang, Bhagat, _________ and Rasiya forms.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rasleela **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ram Dayal Sharma **was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for his contributions to the forms of Nautangi, Swang, Bhagat, Rasleela, and Rasiya.
 
• Ramdayal Sharma is an **Indian Nautanki artist**.
 
• He is **also a singer, composer and teacher**.
 
• In 2022,** he was awarded Padma Shri, and in 2015, the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award by the Indian Government for his contribution in Arts**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Description
 Cultural Significance
 
 

 Khoria
 A traditional folk dance form performed in the regions of Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, often in rural settings. It is associated with agricultural festivals and rituals.
 
 

 Phag
 A folk dance and song form popular in Rajasthan, particularly during the festival of Holi. The songs in Phag depict various aspects of the festival, love, and devotion.
 
 

 Rasleela
 A classical folk dance form that narrates stories from the life of Lord Krishna, focusing on his relationships with Radha and the gopis (female devotees). It is highly theatrical and involves singing and dancing.
 
 

 Matki
 A folk dance performed during the Janmashtami festival in Rajasthan and other regions of North India, where participants form human pyramids to break pots filled with yogurt, a symbolic act of Lord Krishna’s childhood.
